stories.story_fr: Jacobs atteint un carnet de commandes record de 27,0 Mds $ au T2 FY2026, en hausse de 22% sur un an, avec un ratio prises de commandes sur facturation de 1,4x sur 12 mois glissants. La croissance est portee par les centres de donnees, les semi-conducteurs, l'eau, l'energie et le transport au sein du segment Infrastructure & Advanced Facilities.
stories.story_en: Jacobs reached a record backlog of $27.0 billion in Q2 FY2026, up 22% year-on-year, with a TTM book-to-bill ratio of 1.4x. Growth is led by Data Center, Semiconductor, Water, Energy & Power and Transportation sectors within Infrastructure & Advanced Facilities.
stories.signal: Visibilite revenu futur en forte hausse

stories.story_fr: Jacobs a finalise l'acquisition de la participation restante dans PA Consulting et releve son estimation de synergies de couts a plus de 20 M$ sur 24 mois. PA Consulting affiche une croissance de revenu de 17% sur un an au T2, son quatrieme trimestre consecutif de croissance a deux chiffres.
stories.story_en: Jacobs completed the acquisition of the remaining stake in PA Consulting and raised its cost synergy estimate to $20 million+ within 24 months. PA Consulting posted 17% year-on-year revenue growth in Q2, its fourth consecutive quarter of double-digit top line growth.

stories.story_fr: Engineering News-Record classe Jacobs n1 cabinet de conception et n1 dans le secteur manufacturier. La societe rachete pour 220 M$ d'actions au T2 (472 M$ depuis le debut de l'exercice) et releve ses previsions FY2026 pour le deuxieme trimestre consecutif.
stories.story_en: Engineering News-Record ranks Jacobs the #1 Design Firm and #1 in Manufacturing. The company repurchased $220 million of shares in Q2 ($472 million year-to-date) and raised its FY2026 guidance for the second consecutive quarter.
